description: Combine one scoped website, an optional JSON OpenAPI comparison and selected finalized Base evidence into one bounded release brief. Separate provenance and missing/conflicting evidence; a release-label mention never proves deployment or causality. One fixed workflow charge; internal steps never create separate customer charges. First source use seeds state in this same operation; later observations use returned owned observation_id. Auth: authorized native-USDC x402 v2 on Base, enabled MPP, or an eligible prepaid key plus exact tariff 5 and max_credits. Ordinary unpaid calls return a challenge, not execution. Persist original input, proof and recovery token before submission; exact replay returns retained results without fresh work or another charge. Choose evidence detail before authorization. No free-trial or automatic paid fallback. 0.040 USDC or 16 credits. Limits and scope are authoritative, not a complete audit or compatibility guarantee. The same fixed x402 service price may also be paid in native Circle USDC on Solana Mainnet (solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp), when advertised by the unpaid challenge. Explicitly select one accepted network and pin its mint, merchant, amount and sponsored fee payer before signing. Solana payers need no Base wallet; MPP remains Base-only. Payment network does not change the observed chain: blockchain products still inspect finalized Base. Solana delivery requires finalized matching USDC evidence. Persist the original network, resource, input, proof and private recovery capability; never switch networks or authorize a replacement after uncertainty.

api_url.description: Optional explicit JSON OpenAPI source for a new cross-domain identity; no link discovery. Saved observation_id freezes this URL too.

compare_to.description: Default previous compares with the latest successful workflow observation; baseline compares with its original seed. Seeding is one paid workflow operation and reports no comparison, never a second internal charge.

detail.description: Default compact: at most 20 evidence items per section. Expanded allows at most 200 document findings or 100 Base events and retains raw validated logs/getter ABI details within the same fixed work/output ceiling. Counts and omitted-evidence warnings remain explicit.

observation_id.description: Owned observation_id returned by this same workflow. Reuses its immutable source/scope and saved baseline/latest observations; not a primitive watch_id. Seven-day state retention. Missing, foreign or expired IDs never silently rebaseline.

onchain.description: Required with url for a new cross-domain identity. One narrow finalized Base brief; its addresses become immutable and share one existing 18-RPC reservation.

chain_id.description: Base mainnet only; provider chain is verified. All state is pinned to one selected finalized block.

contract_address.description: One selected contract which is also the token-facts and Transfer-log contract. The workflow does not infer that arbitrary bytecode is a safe or compliant token.

wallet_address.description: One selected wallet. Returns its exact native-ETH balance and this contract's provider-reported Transfer events at the single selected finalized block, not complete wallet history.

release_label.description: Claimed release identifier. Exact source mentions are evidence only, never authentication, deployment proof or causality. May change between observations without changing source identity.

scope.description: Immutable supported normalization rules. Selected attributes participate in change detection; ignored fields are outside the reported scope. No browser execution or linked-page crawling.

html_attributes.description: For workflow HTML, default is all four supported attributes: href,title,alt,aria-label. Explicit [] requests text-only comparison and is reported as limited scope. Ignored selectors apply to both text and attribute evidence. Not applied to JSON/text.

items.description: One explicitly observed HTML attribute: href (a/area only),title,alt or aria-label. No class/style/event attributes; links are inert evidence and never fetched.

ignore_json_paths.description: Optional array of up to 20 JSON Pointer-style paths to remove before JSON normalization and hashing. Each must start with '/' and be 1-256 characters; supports '*' segments. Default: [] (no exclusions). JSON only. Example: ['/updated_at', '/items/*/request_id'].

items.description: JSON Pointer-style path, 1-256 characters, starting with '/'. Decode '~0' as '~' and '~1' as '/'; '*' matches all object keys or array elements. Example: '/items/*/updated_at'.

ignore_selectors.description: Optional array of up to 20 CSS selectors (each 1-256 characters) to remove from HTML in addition to built-in noise filtering. Default: no extra exclusions ([]). HTML only; use ignore_json_paths for JSON. Example: ['.timestamp', '.ad'].

items.description: HTML element(s) to remove before normalization: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. '.timestamp' or 'nav'.

selector.description: Optional HTML scope: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. 'main' or 'article .content'. Only matching text is normalized; no match returns 422. Omit to normalize the page after built-in noise removal. Not supported for JSON or plain text.

url.description: Public HTTPS source for a new or existing canonical source/scope identity. Supply exactly one of url or observation_id. A new identity seeds once; the next operation compares.
